summary: On paper Jacksonville has the edge (Jacksonville ranks 6th in EPA per dropback, +0.21), while Houston's best counter is to win up front (Houston's defense ranks 5th in pressure rate, 25% generated). Under center, C.J. Stroud ranks 5th of 23 in EPA per dropback and Trevor Lawrence ranks 7th; x-factor: Parker Washington gets 25% of Jacksonville's targets and 38% of its air yards, and Houston's pass defense ranks 19th. The model favors Jacksonville at 67%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.6 pts) and passing matchup (1.2 pts).
